title: 1.6 Ask about a routine and report it accurately
unit_outcome: Explain a working day, compare two people’s commitments, check assumptions and account for a change of routine.
lesson_title: Ask about a routine and report it accurately
sub_lesson_title: Ask about a routine and report it accurately
goal: Ask a person how often a familiar activity happens, understand the answer and relay an accurate routine profile to another person.
grammar_function: Obtain a genuinely missing recurrence detail and carry it faithfully from a first-person answer into a report about the speaker. Fewer new targets permit a richer interview and relay task, not repeated isolated frequency cards.
prerequisite: 1.5 always/never/usually/sometimes/every day meaning distinctions in familiar I/you statements 1.2 reporting another speaker with known selected third-person forms; A1 study, work, home/library/night and Do you...?
speaking_outcome: Intelligible How often in the complete question; studies retains a clear ending without an added final syllable. Keep speaker attribution and meaningful frequency contrast audible.
